Get into the Starcraft Tabletop Miniatures Game. Preorders till April 17, 2026 https://starcraft-tmg.com/?utm_source=play_on_tabletop&utm_medium=influencer&utm_campaign=starcraft_tmg_preorders&utm_content=battle_report

We play the Starcraft Tabletop Miniatures Game from Archon Studio! Tycho and Tak, fans of the Starcraft franchise, have been waiting for a tabletop miniatures game and now it's here! 

In this gameplay video we see Tak pilot the Terrans while Tycho commands the swarm. We are playing with the Starter Set.
